body_lead: BHUBANESWAR: Amid growing concerns over question paper leaks in national-level exams, the state government is planning to reform and strengthen its examination and evaluation process by introducing artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated systems and reducing human interventions at different levels. State Higher Education department authorities revealed the plans at the two-day vice-chancellors conference which kicked off at Lok Bhavan here on Sunday.
